data.name: Settings_Extension_HelpDialogBody
data.value:
You can register image extensions beyond the default PNG/JPG/JPEG by adding them in the field below.
1. Enter an image extension (e.g. .bmp) and click Register Extension. 2. Click Choose in Windows Default Apps. 3. Change that extension's current app to Mini Capture Viewer.
Due to Windows security policy, an app cannot silently change the existing default app.
